Edge Detection:
Bee-Line Edge Explorer

In this activity, you will discover how image gradients reveal boundaries, compare the expressive responses of Sobel with the thin binary contours of Canny, and learn how blur and thresholds influence what a computer decides is an edge.

  • Preprocess noise
  • Measure gradients
  • Compare edge maps

Activity reflection

Learning to see the boundary, not only the object.

Edge detection transforms an image into evidence about change. By comparing Sobel and Canny, this activity connects mathematical gradients with an observable visual result: intensity variation becomes structure.

Preprocessing
Noise reduction stabilizes later measurements.
Gradients
Direction and magnitude describe local intensity change.
Thresholds
Parameter choices determine which boundaries survive.
Application
Edges support segmentation, features, and object analysis.
